rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a physical location, and it is also used for a player's place and duties on a field.

example.english: Stand in this position so I can take your photo.
example.traditional: 你企喺呢個位置，我先影到你。
example.jyutping: nei5 kei5 hai2 ni1 go3 wai6 zi3 ngo5 sin1 jeng2 dou2 nei5

rows.note: Use this for an employment post or official job position rather than a general location.

example.english: I want to apply for this position.
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 san1 cing2 ni1 go3 zik1 wai6

rows.note: Use this for someone's stated opinion or stance on an issue, rather than their rank or physical position.

example.english: I understand your position, but I disagree.
example.traditional: 我明白你嘅立場，但係我唔同意。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ming4 baak6 nei5 ge3 lap6 coeng4 daan6 hai6 ngo5 m4 tung4 ji3

rows.note: Use this for the way someone holds or arranges their body, rather than their place or status.

example.english: The position of your body looks very unnatural.
example.jyutping: nei5 go3 zi1 sai3 hou2 m4 zi6 jin4 wo3
